Keybound Brawler, a new event that tests your typing prowess, is coming to the Manderville Gold Saucer! The first iteration of the event will be a special collaboration with the FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE series.
Participate in the collaboration stages to obtain MGC which can be exchanged for numerous rewards, including collaboration attire, a mount, emote, and more!

**Event Duration**
From Wednesday, October 28, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. (PDT) / 8:00 (GMT) / 19:00 (AEDT)
to the release of Patch 8.0

**\* The end date listed on Steam does not reflect the release date for Patch 8.0.**
**How to Participate**
Begin the quest "Keyward Bound" by speaking to the Catlike Mammet in The Gold Saucer (X:5.4 Y:7.0).
\* Players must be level 15 and above to start the quest.
\* Players must first complete one of the following main scenario quests: "The Gridanian Envoy," "The Ul'dahn Envoy," or "The Lominsan Envoy."
\* Players must first complete the quest "It Could Happen to You" to be able to travel to the Manderville Gold Saucer via airship from any of the three city-states.
\* Please note that a keyboard is required to participate in this content. Gamepads and on-screen keyboards cannot be used.

**Rewards**
\* After this collaboration event has ended, it will be held as a special event at irregular intervals.
[Visit the special site for more details.](https://sqex.to/zfxMP)
